kind: human listening decision on the built-in-speaker English audition

audition.instruction: Speak clearly and naturally, as though reading a line from an audiobook to a single listener.

humanReview.prompt: Which of the nine auditioned built-in speakers are usable for English narration?

decision.result: All nine built-in speakers are approved for English use at the auditioned instruction
decision.coverage: The approval covers each speaker rendering English at the exact auditioned instruction. It is not an approval of any other instruction: the engine matches on (speaker, instruction, seedSalt), so a differently-instructed profile for the same speaker is unapproved material and needs its own listening decision.
decision.seedNote: Production derives a per-segment seed from the profile seedSalt, so approved audio is evidence that the speaker and instruction are acceptable, not a prediction of exact output bytes. This is the same basis on which the original three profiles were approved under issue 8.

supersedes.previousValue: rejected for English use in this bootstrap decision
supersedes.newValue: approved for English use at the issue-92 audition instruction
supersedes.reason: The issue-8 rejection judged Serena under the issue-8 audition's own instructions. The issue-92 audition put every speaker through one identical English transcript and instruction, and the same human accepted all nine. The reversal is a new judgment on new evidence, not a correction of the earlier one; the earlier record stays as written.

redaction.sourceText: none; the audition transcript was written for the audition and is from no book
